name: Pedro Sánchez
quote: This is not a succession of isolated events. It is the most painful expression of a climate emergency — one that is making wildfires even more violent, heat waves more frequent.

name: Emmanuel Macron
quote: This is completely unprecedented — the toughest fight we've faced since the Second World War. Stay strong. We will win this battle together.

name: Hadja Lahbib
role: EU Commissioner for Equality, Preparedness and Crisis Management
quote: It's a race against time. We're working round the clock to get every available aircraft and firefighter to where they're needed most.

name: European Commission Spokesperson
quote: These fires are out of capacity — we are scrambling to source every additional aircraft we can from partner countries.

name: Ilie Bolojan
quote: We are declaring a nationwide state of alert in the energy sector for August. Every measure to protect the Cernavodă plant's cooling capacity is being pursued.

name: Simon Stiell
quote: This heatwave has the fingerprints of the climate crisis all over it.

name: Protección Civil Spokesperson
quote: The Ávila-Madrid fire front is currently beyond the capacity of firefighters to contain. We are prioritizing the evacuation of at-risk populations over active suppression.

name: Sécurité Civile Spokesperson
quote: More than 220,000 residents have been evacuated from the Gironde fire zone. Our priority remains zero loss of life.

name: World Weather Attribution Research Team
quote: Under a 1976 climate baseline, temperatures of this magnitude would have been virtually impossible. Fossil-fuel-driven warming is the decisive factor.

name: Copernicus Climate Change Service
quote: Western Europe has just experienced its hottest June on record, 3.06°C above the 1991-2020 average — surpassing the previous record set only a year earlier.

name: Hellenic Fire Service Spokesperson
quote: We have logged more than 70 separate fire outbreaks this summer. Attica and Evia remain at the highest operational readiness level given extreme dryness and volatile winds.

name: CSIC Forestry Research Scientist
quote: Decades of rural abandonment have let scrubland and dry biomass accumulate across our mountains. Forest management plans are built for decades, but the climate is changing far faster than that timescale.

name: Ilie Bolojan
quote: Realistically, in two to three years we could finalize the works and ensure cooling water for Cernavodă — this investment will be unblocked and financed from the state budget.
